o.text: Internationalism; likely via Russian амфитеа́тр (amfiteátr), from Latin amphitheatrum, from Ancient Greek ἀμφιθέατρον (amphithéatron).
From sığ- + -ın. Cognate with Turkish sığınmak, Turkmen sygynmak, Kumyk сыйынмакъ (sıyınmaq).
Borrowed from Persian بی وجه. By surface analysis, bi- + vec.
